card.name: Words before IV line or route type
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, through, via, either, using and including that come right before a type of IV line or catheter (peripheral, central, dedicated, separate). Also fires on one digit inside a drug name.

modes.label: Link word before line type
modes.description: A small word after administer, via, through or using, just before peripheral, central or dedicated line or catheter.
modes.example: administration through<< a>> peripheral venous catheter is approximately phosph

modes.label: Injector or device phrase
modes.description: The word a after using, before a power or pressure injector.
modes.example: 1.5 mL/kg body weight using<< a>> power injector at 2 mL/second

modes.label: Digit in drug name
modes.description: A digit inside the radiotracer name Technetium Tc 99m.
